title: Following a beat clock starts bar 1 on the clock's next bar line
description:
As a performer, I want playback to start on the clock's next bar line, so that bar 1 of my score lands where the DAW's bar does.

Spec file: `features/link/clock.feature` (runner `crates/apricity-engine/tests/clock.rs`). "The tolerance" is the native one in `design/link.md`. "The click score" is the M1 fixture: 4 bars of 4/4 at 100 BPM, a click on every beat, louder on beat 1.

```gherkin
Feature: Following a beat clock
  The engine can follow a beat clock from outside instead of its own. The clock says which beat it
  is at a given moment, how fast beats pass, whether it plays, and how many beats make a bar (the
  quantum). These scenarios drive the engine with a scripted clock and listen to what it plays.

  Background:
    Given the click score

  Scenario: Start on the next bar line
    Given a clock at 120 BPM, playing, at beat 5.5, with a quantum of 4
    When I start playback following the clock
    Then nothing sounds before the clock reaches beat 8
    And a loud click sounds at beat 8 within the tolerance
    And every later click sounds on a whole beat of the clock within the tolerance

  Scenario: Starting exactly on a bar line starts at once
    Given a clock at 120 BPM, playing, at beat 8, with a quantum of 4
    When I start playback following the clock
    Then a loud click sounds at beat 8 within the tolerance

  Scenario: The loop comes round on the clock's bar lines
    Given playback started following a clock at 120 BPM at beat 8
    When the clock has played 10 bars
    Then bar 1 of the score has sounded at beats 8, 24 and 40

  Scenario: A stopped clock keeps playback waiting
    Given a clock at 120 BPM that is stopped
    When I start playback following the clock
    Then nothing sounds
    When the clock plays from beat 0
    Then a loud click sounds at beat 0 within the tolerance
```
